author: reek
body: The electrical netlist -- the graph of connectivity between component pins. This is the central data structure that bridges schematic capture and PCB layout. Every wire in the schematic and every trace on the board ultimately references a net in this model.

author: reek
body: A pin is identified by its parent component reference designator and its pin number or name within that component.

author: reek
body: The electrical type of a pin determines ERC compatibility. Two output pins on the same net is an error. An unconnected input is a warning.

author: reek
body: A net is a named electrical connection between two or more pins. Nets carry their net class assignment which determines DRC constraints.

author: reek
body: A net class groups nets that share electrical constraints. The DRC engine uses these constraints to verify trace width, clearance, impedance, and length matching.

author: reek
body: The complete netlist for a design: all nets, all net classes, and component-to-footprint assignments.
